The problem

Why teams overspend on AI tooling

AI software costs are growing faster than visibility into how those tools are actually being used.

43%of AI seats go unused

Teams provision licenses during onboarding and never audit them. Inactive seats accumulate silently across ChatGPT, Copilot, and Cursor.

2.4×average vendor overlap

Most engineering teams run ChatGPT and Claude simultaneously for the same workflows. Consolidating saves 20–35% without changing output quality.

68%of teams lack spend visibility

AI software spend is fragmented across individual credit cards, team budgets, and corporate accounts. No one has the full picture.

$8,400average annual waste per team

Across inactive seats, duplicate tools, and unused premium plans, the median 20-person engineering team wastes $700/month on AI tooling.

Platform

Everything your team needs to control AI spend

Built for engineering and finance teams who need visibility without complexity.

Multi-provider spend dashboard

One view across ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini. Track monthly spend, seat counts, and utilization rates without switching tabs.

Seat utilization analysis

Identify inactive seats, casual users, and over-provisioned licenses. See exactly which team members haven't used a tool in 30 days.

Deterministic audit engine

13 rule-based checks across 5 providers produce explainable, finance-friendly recommendations — no LLM hallucinations, no black-box outputs.

Vendor overlap detection

Automatically flags redundant subscriptions — Cursor + Copilot on the same team, ChatGPT + Claude for identical workflows, and more.

Soon

Recurring spend monitoring

Schedule monthly re-audits to catch new waste as your team grows, adds seats, or onboards new AI tools.

Shareable audit reports

How it works

From connected to savings in under 10 minutes

01

Connect your AI tools

Add your providers in under 2 minutes. Ledgerly connects to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini using read-only access — no changes to your workflows.

02

Analyze spend and utilization

Our deterministic audit engine runs 13 rule-based checks across seat utilization, vendor overlap, inactive licenses, and API vs subscription mismatches.

03

Receive optimization recommendations

Get a prioritized list of savings opportunities — each with a confidence score, affected user count, and estimated annual savings. Share directly with your CFO.

Security & trust

Built for finance and engineering teams that need to trust the numbers

SOC 2 Ready

All data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Audit logs retained for 12 months. Access controls enforced at the row level.

Deterministic Audits

Every recommendation traces back to a named rule and a concrete formula. No LLM-generated savings estimates. No hallucinated numbers.

Explainable Recommendations

Each finding includes the rule ID, the threshold that triggered it, the affected users, and the exact savings calculation — reviewable by your finance team.

Enterprise Infrastructure

Deployed on Vercel Edge with Supabase PostgreSQL and Row Level Security. Your data is never shared across organizations.
